properties.name: Kata Tjuta (The Olgas)
properties.description: 36 domed rock formations sacred to men's initiation ceremonies. Many stories are restricted — only initiated men may know the full Dreaming.
properties.modernStatus: UNESCO World Heritage Site, parts restricted to public

properties.name: Uluru (Ayers Rock)
properties.description: Sacred sandstone monolith central to Anangu Dreaming. Every crack, cave, and waterhole records ancestor stories. Rising 348m from the desert.
properties.modernStatus: UNESCO World Heritage Site, climbing banned since 2019
